item.title: Survey shows people cutting back on air-conditioners as WA records third-hottest year
item.description: WA has recorded its third-hottest year on record but a survey has shown soaring power bills are forcing people to turn off their air-conditioners.

item.title: North West leaders share their visions for 2026
item.description: Regional leaders have shared their plans for the new year.

item.title: Callum Ah Chee making waves at Adelaide Crows preseason training
item.description: Two-time AFL premiership player Callum Ah Chee who hails from Derby in the West Kimberley is making waves at his new football club, the Adelaide Crows, impressing his new teammates at pre-season training

item.title: Kimberley fracking plan sparks protest
item.description: More than 100 protesters gathered in Broome to oppose the Valhalla Gas Exploration and Appraisal Program approval

item.title: Kalumburu flooded during heavy rainfall in the East Kimberley
item.description: Heavy rainfall in the East Kimberley saw the remote community of Kalumburu flooded on Monday (January 19) with some 107.8mm of rain recorded between Sunday and Monday.

item.title: Contract awarded for community mental health facility in Broome
item.description: A contract has been awarded to EMCO for the six-bed residential Broome Step Up/Step Down service.

item.title: Australia’s biggest regional Mardi Gras is coming to Broome
Djarindjin Aboriginal Corporation calls for fuel and freight costs regulations as food prices surge
item.description: Djarindjin Aboriginal Corporation is calling for changes to the fuel excise and regulations for freighting company surcharges, which they say is driving food insecurity in Kimberley remote communities.
